verdict.rationale: Pika documents clip extension directly. It can make a clip longer by generating extra frames, and it can generate a continuation from the clip's final frame, so the existing footage is not re-rendered. There is no documented way to regenerate only one time segment of a clip. Pikadditions/Add Elements and Swap Anything edit objects within a video, which is an adjacent feature and not segment regeneration. Missing for 10: regenerating a chosen segment of a clip in isolation, explicit confirmation that edits avoid re-rendering the whole video, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the extend feature.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video

citations.quote: Make any clip longer than its original by generating extra frames
Upload your clip and generate a continuation from its final frame to keep the scene and action moving.
